content: Unlocked by CL-7. The C function (65 lines) finds the existing tag, compares the old string length with the new one, shifts the data buffer if lengths differ, and writes the new NUL-terminated string. Our aux_tag_search + aux_payload_size handle the find+old-size logic. The resize pattern is the same as bam_aux_update_int.
